factual_claims.source_evidence: Administrative expenses amounted to ISK 2,947 m., decreasing by 1.1% YoY despite one-off costs of ISK 112 m. in the quarter attributable to cost efficiency measures in June

factual_claims.claim: Employee numbers fell to 232, and efficiency measures are expected to reduce the annual cost base by ISK 300–400 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Employee count decreased to 232 at the end of Q2... Efficiency measures announced in June expected to achieve annualised cost savings of ISK 3-400 m.

factual_claims.claim: Net impairment charges rose to ISK 269 million from ISK 122 million as the bank applied a more conservative loan-book review.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net impairment (269) (122) _(147)_... The increase in Stage 3 exposures is primarily driven by a single well collateralised UK exposure... Overall impairment levels remain low and stable at 1.2% of the gross loan book

factual_claims.claim: The effective income tax rate increased to 34.8% from 24.4%, mainly because of higher special tax on financial activities related to the closure of funding derivatives.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The effective income tax rate increased to 34.8% in Q2 2026 from 24.4% in Q2 2025, mainly reflecting higher special tax on financial activities related to the closure of funding derivatives

factual_claims.claim: For the first six months, continuing-operations pre-tax profit increased 23.0% to ISK 3,354 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Pre-tax profit from continuing operations increasing by 23.0% YoY to ISK 3,354 m.

factual_claims.claim: Net operating income rose 0.7% to ISK 9,643 million, supported by 6.8% growth in net interest income and a ISK 219 million increase in other operating income, while fees declined 16.0% and administrative expenses fell 1.8%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net operating income amounted to ISK 9,643 m., increasing 0.7% YoY... Net interest income increased by 6.8% YoY... Other net operating income increased by ISK 219 m. YoY... Net fee and commission income decreased by 16.0% YoY... Administrative expenses amounted to ISK 5,961 m., a 1.8% decrease YoY

factual_claims.claim: After-tax profit from continuing operations increased to ISK 2,277 million from ISK 1,625 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: After-tax profit from continuing operations increased to ISK 2,277 m. from ISK 1,625 m.

factual_claims.claim: However, profit for the period declined to ISK 2,277 million from ISK 3,525 million because the prior-year figure included ISK 1,901 million from discontinued operations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit for the period... Profit after tax from discontinued operations: - (1,901) _(1,901)_... Profit for the period: 2,277 3,525 _(1,249)_

factual_claims.claim: The balance sheet expanded alongside continued lending and deposit growth.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Total assets amounted to ISK 375.7 bn. at the end of Q2 2026, increasing by 9.5% from year-end 2025... Loans to customers amounted to ISK 223.3 bn., increasing by 7.6% from year-end 2025... Deposits increased to ISK 201.2 bn., up 16.5% from year-end 2025

factual_claims.claim: Loans to customers rose 7.6% from year-end 2025 to ISK 223.3 billion, while deposits increased 16.5% to ISK 201.2 billion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Loans to customers amounted to ISK 223.3 bn. at the end of Q2 2026, increasing by ISK 15.8 bn., or 7.6%, from year-end 2025... Deposits amounted to ISK 201.2 bn. at the end of Q2 2026, increasing by 16.5% from year-end 2025

factual_claims.claim: Liquidity remained strong, with an LCR of 276% and NSFR of 137%, and the capital adequacy ratio stood at 23.0%, 530 basis points above the total capital requirement.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) remains strong at 276%... NSFR stood at 137%... CAR of 23.0% at 30 June 2026... management buffer of 2% to 4% over current and anticipated CAR requirements [total capital requirement was 17.7%]

factual_claims.claim: Strategic developments included the ongoing sale process for Straumur greiðslumiðlun, expected to close before year-end, and the CEO’s planned departure by the end of 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Sale of Straumur greiðslumiðlun hf. in progress... Due diligence underway following a formal sales process... Ármann has requested to step down from his position after nearly ten years with the Group. He will continue to serve as CEO while the Board recruits his successor
